---
# Negative control for the watermark switch. `watermark: false` reaches the
# template as the STRING "false", because the Pandoc template interpolates it
# rather than testing it with `$if()$` — which is the only way to tell an
# explicit `false` from an absent key.
#
# Every other string is stamped as written, deliberately, so the one thing
# standing between `watermark: false` and the word FALSE across the poster is
# the off-switch list in sciposter(). Nothing else in the suite would notice
# if it were dropped.
title: "Watermark off fixture"
format:
  sciposter-typst:
    poster:
      size: a1
      columns: 1
      watermark: false
---

Body.
